summary: IPG Photonics Corp filed an 8-K regarding a Put Option Agreement with Lumibird S.A. to acquire 100% of Lumibird Medical for €300 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, payable at closing in cash, plus up to €50 million contingent earnout based on 2026-2027 performance. The acquisition is to be funded from cash on hand. The put option remains exercisable after consultation with the French works council and expires 10 business days post-consultation or after six months. A €3.5M reverse break fee applies if Lumibird fails to exercise. Watch for regulatory clearance and the earnout milestones for risk-arb analysis.
